qa_pair.question: The site has power supervisors that power-cycle a PoE port when a device goes silent. Taking the supervisor that protects the access point named "AP-AC-Mesh", on which port number of the switch that powers it is that access point connected? Answer with the number only.

For the power supervisor that protects the access point named "AP-AC-Pro", how many seconds is the configured power-off duration (how long the port stays unpowered during a power cycle)? Answer with the number only.

Two switches have very similar names: "Switch 8" (model USC8) and "Switch 8 PoE-60W". Switch 8 (the USC8) is uplinked to another switch. On which port number of that upstream switch does its uplink terminate? Answer with the number only.
Across all of the site's switches, what is the lowest (most preferred) STP bridge priority value that is configured? Answer with the number only.
The zone-based firewall has built-in zones and custom zones. Custom zones are the ones with no zone_key. How many custom firewall zones exist? Answer with the number only.
How many user-defined (non-predefined) firewall policies have the IoT zone as their source and the Internal zone as their destination? Answer with the number only.
On the switch named "Switch 16 PoE", how many ports are configured as STP edge ports? Answer with the number only.
Among the PoE-enabled ports of the switch "Switch 16 PoE", look at the one with the highest port number. What is the name of the port (the device it is labelled for)?
What fixed IP address is assigned to the known client named "Amazon Echo"? Answer with the address only.
How many of the site's switches are running the plain STP protocol version (stp) rather than rstp? Answer with the number only.
